card.name: Geriatric dose selection and cross-references
card.fires_on: The word "be" after "dose selection ... should" in geriatric-use text, and "Clinical" after "[see" in cross-references to Clinical Pharmacology.

modes.label: Dose selection should be
modes.description: The word "be" right after "should" in sentences about choosing doses for elderly patients.
modes.example: In general, dose selection for an elderly patient should<< be>> cautious, usually starting at the low end

modes.label: See Clinical Pharmacology
modes.description: The word "Clinical" after "[see" in a section cross-reference.
modes.example: with strong CYP3A inducers may decrease idelalisib concentrations [see<< Clinical>> Pharmacology (12.3)
